optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: linear warmup for 16 optimizer updates, then constant

reference_kl.normalization: sum over observed decisions divided by (6 * complete_games_in_update)
reference_kl.freeze: both LoRA adapter and pointer head; never move reference

consistency.normalization: sum over observed decisions divided by (6 * complete_games_in_update)

probe_auxiliary.target_source: postgame public history, all 2315 public answers, offered words; never actual secret
probe_auxiliary.eligibility: turn == 5 and N > 2 and max(Q5) > max(Q5 of offered consistent words) + 1e-12
probe_auxiliary.value: Q5(a) = number of nonempty exact-feedback buckets induced on S by a / len(S)
probe_auxiliary.target: all offered actions within 1e-12 of maximum Q5
probe_auxiliary.loss: -log(sum(policy_probability[a] for a in optimal_set)) at temperature 1
probe_auxiliary.normalization: mean over eligible states in these completed games, separate from easy states
probe_auxiliary.empty_eligible_set: zero loss; explicitly log zero count

validation.order_flip_population: every decision in every validation game
validation.mean_tv: mean of 0.5 * sum(abs(p-q)) over word-aligned permuted distributions
